source_title: Why Operationalizing Governance Gives Banks an Advantage in Scaling AI
data_period: 2026 banking AI governance benchmark (field dates not disclosed)
figure_ref: Article reported governance statistics (editorial; not exhibit reproduction)
business_context: Banks expanding autonomous agents while governance controls and inventories lag policy adoption.
key_message: AI 운영 허용 73%, 전용 AI 정책 77%와 달리 Agent 전반 통제체계를 갖춘 은행은 8%로, AI 활용과 실행 가능한 통제를 별도로 관리해야 한다.
original_chart_type: Two-dimensional AI adoption vs risk maturity segmentation (exhibit); this bar design does not reproduce that exhibit

encoding.x: reported value, percentage points for net sentiment; percentage for banking shares
encoding.axis: 0 reference line; no truncated x origin

data_spec.denominator: 26 surveyed global and domestic systemically important banks (percentage rounded; survey question applicability may vary)
data_spec.time_basis: 2026 banking AI governance benchmark (field dates not disclosed)
data_spec.comparison: Marginal percentages for different questions; categories overlap and are not a funnel or cohort transition.
data_spec.sample: 26 major banks worldwide; official report states 26; exact per-question bases not disclosed.

data_recipe: Define survey questions and institution eligibility for each control.
Create binary institution × governance-condition indicators; retain per-question denominator.
Compute 100 × number meeting condition / number answering, without treating categories as sequential stages.
Select target metric and use common 0–100% axis; inspect missing responses and rounding.
message_conditions: Each proportion is a marginal share of responding institutions for a distinct question.
A 69pp or 65pp difference is NOT the fraction of banks missing the control.
Survey n=26, exact effective denominators and sampling intervals not disclosed; no causal conclusions.
design_moves: Direct-label each bar instead of a legend.
Rank shares to foreground policy vs agent-controls imbalance.
Highlight controls in a contrasting style without implying paired respondent transitions.
diff_notes: Published article numbers checked; original exhibit visually not verified; editorial redesign rather than original reproduction.

training_pair.instruction: From bank AI risk benchmark marginal percentages, create a reproducible neutral and source-themed ranked horizontal bar without conflating policy adoption with agent-specific controls.

run_commands: python chart.py --data data.csv --config config.json --theme source --output source.png
python chart.py --data data.csv --config config.json --theme neutral --output neutral.png

data_rows.source_note: Standard monitoring and controls explicitly cover AI agents

response.script: chart.py in this immutable bundle; execute with pandas/matplotlib; input fields explicitly mapped in CONTEXT
